item.description:
Insight 0.2.2

  • Fixed a crash on launch — the app now loads its bundled resources correctly on every Mac (0.2.0 and 0.2.1 could quit immediately on machines other than the build host).
  • Adds an app icon and staples the notarization ticket so first launch is clean, even offline.

If you were stuck on an earlier build, please download this version directly — a crashing build can’t auto-update itself.
